origins.section: A Constructor That Fails Has Already Published this If It Registered Itself First
An Immutable Class Is final, and Copies Every Mutable Part, Not Just the Collection
Deserialization Builds the Object Without Your Constructor, So readObject Checks Again
Reflection Can Rewrite a private final Field of a Class, but Not of a Record

IllegalArgumentException'; text: 'ObjectInputStream runs only the no-arg constructor of the first superclass that isn't serializable ... A record is rebuilt through its canonical constructor.'

recorded.pass:q-seat-becomes-record: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-seat-becomes-record: Reflection section output 'class field set: nights=-1' and 'record: java.lang.IllegalAccessException: Can not set final int field Around$StayRecord.nights'; 'Field.set writes a final field only if it is non-static and its class is neither a record nor a hidden class.' Summary: 'A test that does it breaks when the class becomes a record.'
